title: SFBond 실버폭스 #062 · 이레즈미 · 목-발목 Y자 체인 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · Middle Eastern · early 50s · 헤어 vintage victory rolls framing the face
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Middle Eastern woman, a warm olive complexion, early 50s silver fox goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, silver-white vintage victory rolls framing the face — full body lotus pond irezumi covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Bold black ink outlines — BLAZING VIVID PINK lotus blooms across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, DEEP EMERALD lotus leaf formations filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A light dusting of soot sits on her cheek and chin, with a little dirt on her hands and bare feet. Her expression is a composed expression with a faint weariness in her eyes. Restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ankle fetter joined by its own short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, to one single huge black iron ring held low between her feet, so that the two ankle chains run from her two ankles and meet at that one ring. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, hangs straight down the front of her body and is joined to that same ring between her feet, so that the neck chain and both ankle chains all meet at that one ring, the long chain hanging in a gentle slack curve. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her feet a hand's width apart, her arms relaxed at her sides, the long chain hanging down the center of her body to the ring between her feet in view, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long almond glossy nails pink emerald tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
